description: This file exports configuration data for unit tests, including patterns for test files, boundary test files, plugin-dependent test files, and exclusion patterns used to identify and categorize test files within a project.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file path matches the patterns indicating it is a unit configuration test file, considering inclusion and exclusion patterns.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path is part of the bundled plugin dependent unit test files list.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path matches one of the boundary test files.
